checkpoint_review: The Router was appropriately strict. It correctly marked 'structured typography' and 'systematic listing' as absent (false) because the text is gibberish. The only 'present' checkpoints were superficial visual features (decorative borders, paper texture simulation). The Router did not skip any testable checkpoints. I agree with all verdicts: a menu without legible text fails the functional definition of the class.
artifact_review: The Router correctly identified 'text_gibberish' as a severity 5.0 artifact, which is the dominant failure mode. The 'structural_collapse' of text baselines (severity 4.0) is also accurate. The Topology Boundary Auditor's low confidence score (0.74) supports the Router's observation of fusion/bleeding between text and background. The Perceptual Quality Auditor missed the semantic severity of the text issues, focusing only on slight compression, but this does not contradict the Router's findings on structural/textual artifacts.
alignment_reasoning: The image fails almost all functional checkpoints. The Fine Grained Classifier ranked 'menu' only 3rd behind 'crossword puzzle' and 'jigsaw puzzle', confirming that the visual structure resembles a grid of symbols more than a readable document. The Image Text Auditor confirmed total illegibility (gibberish strings like 'YLOETKEFE'). Since a menu's primary function is to convey information via text, the complete lack of legibility results in a near-zero alignment score, despite superficial layout resemblance.
artifact_reasoning: Catastrophic text generation failure. The text is nonsensical, malformed, and lacks linguistic structure (Severity 5.0). Text baselines warp and intersect (Severity 4.0). Boundaries between text and background are fuzzy, evidenced by the low segmentation confidence (0.74). While the color and general 'paper' texture are acceptable, the structural integrity of the document content is nonexistent.
key_defects: Failure to organize items into recognizable categories
Low boundary confidence between text and background
